title: A Wandering Merchant
description: A peddler's cart appears on the road, hung with trinkets and oddities from distant lands. 'A fair price for fair folk,' she calls.

choices.label: Buy a trinket (-50 gold)
choices.description: A small jade amulet catches your eye.

effects.message: You feel oddly comforted by the amulet.

choices.label: Haggle rudely
choices.description: You insult the merchant's wares to drive the price down.

effects.message: She throws coins at you to be rid of you.
You nod politely and continue on your way.

title: A Lost Traveler
description: A dust-covered traveler waves you down. 'Please — which road leads to the next town?'

effects.message: Grateful, the traveler presses a few coins into your hand.
You snicker as they head off the wrong way. Your conscience pricks at you later.

title: An Overgrown Shrine
description: Vines choke a weathered stone shrine half-buried in the undergrowth. Faded offerings lie scattered at its base.

effects.message: A warm breeze stirs. You feel watched — but not unkindly.
The coins jingle in your pouch. The air turns cold.

choices.label: Restore the shrine
choices.description: Hours of clearing vines and righting the stone.

effects.message: By dusk the shrine stands whole again. Wisdom settles over you.

title: A Stray Dog
description: A matted dog trails behind you, tail wagging hopefully. It looks half-starved.

effects.message: The dog devours the scraps and trots loyally at your side for a while.
It whimpers and slinks off into the alleys.

title: Bandit Ambush!
description: Figures step from the treeline. 'Your gold or your blood, traveler.'

effects.message: The bandits vanish into the woods with your purse. You live.
Battered but standing, you take what the fallen left behind.

choices.label: Try to flee
choices.description: Risky — they are fast.

effects.message: You break free at a cost, lungs burning, purse lighter than you thought.

title: A Buried Cache
description: Your boot strikes something hard beneath the soil. Aged linen wraps a small bundle.

effects.message: You shake loose a handful of old coins. The past had generous hands.

title: A Traveling Festival
description: Bright pennants snap in the wind as a wandering market-festival rolls through. Music and laughter fill the air.

effects.message: You dance and feast until your sides ache. The world feels lighter.
Quick fingers, quicker feet. No one notices — except your reflection.

title: Smoke on the Horizon
description: A column of dark smoke rises from a distant hamlet. Something is burning.

effects.message: You help pull survivors from the embers. A grateful family presses reward into your hands.
You turn away. The smoke lingers in your dreams.

title: The Hermit's Wisdom
description: A reclusive hermit beckons from a cave mouth. 'Sit, child of years. The world has much to teach the patient.'

effects.message: Hours pass like water. When you rise, your mind feels sharpened.

title: A Fallen Log Bridge
description: A great tree has fallen across a ravine, forming a precarious crossing. A glint of something gleams on the far side.

effects.message: Heart pounding, you make it across and claim the prize — a pouch of coins.
You find a longer way around. The prize stays where it lies.

title: Runaway Children
description: Two wide-eyed children approach, claiming to have run away from home. They ask for food and directions.

choices.label: Feed and send them home (-15 gold)

effects.message: You buy them bread and point them back to worried parents. You sleep well.
You shrug and walk on. Out here, everyone fends for themselves.

title: A Roadside Grave
description: A simple marker stands by the path, fresh wildflowers laid upon it. The name is weathered beyond reading.

effects.message: You stand a moment in silence. The road feels gentler after.
You pocket the bouquet to sell in town. Your hands feel heavy.

title: A Broken Caravan
description: A trade caravan is stalled, a wheel shattered. The driver waves for help.

effects.message: Grease and sweat — but the driver rewards your labor.
A long, cold watch — but the morning finds the caravan safe and your purse heavier.

title: A Wandering Minstrel
description: A bard with a battered lute strums a tune and beckons you to listen.

choices.label: Toss a coin and listen (-10 gold)

effects.message: The song carries you somewhere far away. You rise refreshed.
The melancholy tune steadies your resolve rather than your mood.

title: Spring Thaw Flood
description: The rivers swell with meltwater. A low bridge is submerged and travelers are stranded.

effects.message: Cold water to the waist, but grateful hands press coin upon you.
You wait on the high bank until the waters recede. Boredom gnaws.

title: Wolves on the Prowl
description: Howls echo across the snowfields. A lean wolf watches you from the treeline, gaunt and hungry.

effects.message: The wolf snatches the meat and slips away. You've made the road safer for now.
A tense standoff ends with the wolf retreating. Your nerves are frayed.

title: Harvest Surplus
description: A farmer waves you over. 'Too much to carry before it spoils — take a share, and a few coins for honest work.'

effects.message: Apples, root vegetables, and a friendly handshake. You leave well-fed.

title: Sweltering Heat
description: The summer sun beats down mercilessly. Your vision swims; the road shimmers ahead.

choices.label: Rest in the shade
choices.description: Lose time, regain strength.

effects.message: You wait out the worst of the heat beneath an oak. Slow, but wise.
Stupid stubbornness. You make your destination and collapse into a bed.

title: An Ill Omen
description: A flock of crows circles overhead as you pass a crossroads. One drops a single black feather at your feet.

choices.label: Take it as a sign to turn back

effects.message: You retrace your steps. Caution spares you a fall later that day.
You refuse to be ruled by superstition — though the crows seem to follow.

title: A Dropped Purse
description: A heavy purse lies in the dust of the road. No one seems to be looking for it.

effects.message: You pocket the coin. Someone, somewhere, is poorer for it.

choices.label: Return it to town
choices.description: Ask after the owner in the next settlement.

effects.message: The owner, found, rewards your honesty with a small token.

title: An Elder Needs an Escort
description: A frail elder leans on a staff by the road. 'Could you see me to the next village, friend?'

effects.message: A slow walk, but a good one. The elder blesses you at parting.
You apologize and hurry on. The road feels colder behind you.

title: A Ring of Mushrooms
description: Strange, vividly colored mushrooms grow in a perfect ring in a sun-dappled grove.

effects.message: An apothecary in town will pay well for these. You pocket a satchel's worth.
Vivid dreams follow. Whether they were worth the stomachache is debatable.

title: A Carefree Afternoon
description: The world feels wide and bright. You spend an afternoon chasing dragonflies and watching clouds.

effects.message: For a while, the worries of the world feel very far away.

title: A Roadside Philosopher
description: An old man sits on a stone, declaiming to no one in particular. He waves you over and demands you refute him.

effects.message: Sharp words sharpen a sharp mind. You part wiser, exchange grins.
You plaster on a smile until he's satisfied. One less problem in the world.

title: Blinding Blizzard
description: A howling blizzard descends without warning, turning the world white. You can barely see your own hands.

choices.label: Shelter in a snowbank
choices.description: Dig in and wait it out.

effects.message: You burrow into the snow, shivering until the storm passes.

choices.label: Keep moving, find cover
choices.description: Risk injury to find better shelter.

effects.message: You stumble into an abandoned hunter's shack and find a few coins left behind.

title: Frozen Lake
description: A crystalline lake lies frozen solid, its surface etched with strange patterns. Something glimmers beneath the ice.

choices.label: Chip at the ice carefully
choices.description: Hours of painstaking work.

effects.message: Ancient fishing tackle and a pouch of coins emerge from the icy depths.

choices.label: Skate across the surface
choices.description: Dangerous, but exhilarating.

effects.message: You glide across the mirror-like ice. The cold wind in your hair reminds you that you're alive.

title: Hungry Wolf Pack
description: A pack of gaunt wolves circles you, eyes gleaming in the snow-reflected moonlight. They are desperate with hunger.

choices.label: Stand your ground with a torch
choices.description: Fire keeps predators at bay.

effects.message: Your makeshift torch holds them at a distance. They melt back into the dark.
You scramble up a pine and wait long, cold hours until the pack loses interest.

choices.label: Fight them off
choices.description: Desperate measures for desperate times.

effects.message: Bruised and bloodied, you drive them off. A torn pouch spills some coin at your feet.

title: Solstice Ritual
description: Villagers gather around a great bonfire, singing old songs to call back the sun. They welcome travelers to join.

effects.message: The warmth of the fire and the community's hope fill you. You feel the darkness recede, if only for a night.
Festival-goers buy your odds and ends at inflated prices. Business is business.

title: Flooded Lowlands
description: Spring melt has turned the low road into a muddy swamp. Travelers are picking their way along the high ridges.

choices.label: Wade through the mud
choices.description: Unpleasant but direct.

effects.message: Cold, filthy water soaks you to the bone, but you come out the other side.
Together with other travelers you haul logs and stones. The grateful merchant at the front pays in coin.

title: Blooming Garden
description: Behind a crumbling stone wall lies a hidden garden, bursting with flowers in every color. Bees hum lazily in the morning light.

effects.message: You lie in the soft grass and watch petals drift overhead. The world's troubles feel miles away.

choices.label: Harvest rare flowers
choices.description: An apothecary would pay well for these.

effects.message: You carefully pick the rarest blossoms. In town they trade for a tidy sum.

title: Spring Fair
description: A seasonal fair has sprung up in a clearing: games, food stalls, and a fortune teller's tent with faded velvet drapes.

effects.message: Beginner's luck! You win a small prize and a few coins from a losing bettor.
'Your path crosses with a shadow from your past,' she intones. Cryptic — but her words linger.
Quick fingers find the till. You slip away before anyone notices.

title: Desert Oasis
description: A cluster of palm trees and a shimmering spring break the monotonous heat. The water is cool and clear.

effects.message: The water is life itself. You drink deeply and feel renewed.

choices.label: Search for hidden treasure
choices.description: Old tales say something lies beneath.

effects.message: You fish around in the murk and find an ancient coin and a silver bracelet tangled in roots.

title: Severe Drought
description: The sun has not relented for weeks. The ground is cracked, the wells are low, and tempers are short.

effects.message: Backbreaking work under the noon sun, but the villagers share their precious water and pay your wage.

choices.label: Move on quickly
choices.description: Less water used, less trouble.

effects.message: You press on under the merciless sun, saving your canteen for the road ahead.

title: Swarming Insects
description: A dark cloud of insects descends upon you — biting flies, mosquitoes, and things that crawl where they bite.

choices.label: Endure it
choices.description: Cover your face and push through.

effects.message: Bites cover your arms and neck, but the swarm passes. You emerge battered and itchy.

choices.label: Build a smoky fire
choices.description: Drive them off with smoke.

effects.message: The smoke drives them away. You waste some time but escape mostly un-bitten.

title: Harvest Festival Feast
description: Lanterns glow warm in the autumn dusk as the village throws its annual harvest feast. Laughter and music spill from every door.

effects.message: You eat, drink, and dance until the bonfire embers die. The village adopts you for the night.

choices.label: Help with the preparations
choices.description: Earn your keep and some coin.

effects.message: You haul tables, light lanterns, and peel vegetables. The village elder slips you a handful of coins.

title: Migrating Herd
description: The ground trembles as a massive herd of deer and wild goats moves through the valley, heading to their winter grounds.

effects.message: The herd moves like a flowing river of fur and antlers. Nature's raw power humbles you.

choices.label: Hunt a straggler
choices.description: Fresh meat for the road.

effects.message: You bring down a young buck. The meat will feed you for weeks and the hide sells well.

title: Falling-Leaf Shrine
description: Amid a grove of golden-leafed trees sits a small stone shrine, half-buried in a carpet of autumn leaves. The air hums with peace.

choices.label: Clear the leaves and pray
choices.description: Show respect and receive a blessing.

effects.message: You uncover a small offering bowl. The wisdom of the changing season settles in your heart.
You find old coins among the leaves. The shrine's guardian spirit seems to frown.

title: Gale Winds
description: A fierce autumn wind whips through the countryside, tearing leaves from trees and shaking shutters. Travel slows to a crawl.

effects.message: You huddle behind a boulder until the worst passes. Leaves and debris rain around you.
Stubbornness pays — you stagger into the town inn just as the storm peaks. The innkeeper gives you a dry cloth and a nod.
